headline: Eight military personnel k!lled in Peruvian helicopter crash during rescue mission
label: NEWS
caption:
Eight military personnel have been k!lled in a helicopter crash in a remote area of Peru known for growing and trafficking dr*gs 🚁

According to the BBC and other sources, the aircraft came down near the town of Sanabamba during a mission to evacuate an army patrol in the Apurimac, Ene, and Mantaro rivers valley.

The Peruvian ministry of defence stated that the pilot was the sole survivor of the crash, while the cause of the accident remains unknown.

The aircraft was reported missing on Thursday night after rescuing three army personnel, and the pilot was later evacuated to Lima for medical treatment.
